title: faux fur electric throw
text: faux fur electric throw. This is a very nice size for cozy nap or book read... it's big enough to lay over a twin or double and prewarm the bed.  The faux fur is very soft on both sides.  The big satiny care label is on the lighter faux side as is the plug in attachment.  It runs for 4 hours and auto shuts off.  Six levels of warm - I put it on 6 and it took less than a minute to begin to feel the warmth - while it took about 5 minutes for it to fully warm.  The wires that produce the warmth do not go all the way to the edges of the blanket, but within about 5" or so - with corners about 6 or 7" from the wires - in case that matters.  I have not washed it yet - but the label does outline specific guidelines for washing - such as prefilling your washer which may be a problem for front loading washer users.  I have a non electric faux fur blanket that I have machine washed and dried for years even though it says to clean using a "furrier method"... and have had no problems machine washing and it has WAY longer 'fur' than this really short pile faux fur blanket has.  I think it will do well in a delicate wash with delicate soap.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. They did send a card that says "Congratulations You won our special FREE GIFT."  Yeah.  I never sign up or take those - but you might get a free magazine subscription or something.  I never accept ANY compensation of any kind for my reviews, period.
